events.body:
Title: [Regression/Blocker] Desktop app now fails to open at all — "configuration_lock_unavailable" persists across full uninstall/reinstall, indicating a server-side stuck state

Environment: ForkMesh Desktop v1.2.3, Windows (previously v0.8.10)

Steps to Reproduce:
1- Install ForkMesh Desktop v1.2.3
2- Open ForkMesh

Expected Result: The app opens to its normal interface (login screen or dashboard), same as previous versions did.

Actual Result: The app immediately shows a fatal error dialog: "ForkMesh could not recover an interrupted mirror Actions configuration (configuration_lock_unavailable). No Actions services were started." No further access to the app is possible — this is a regression from v0.8.10, which at least opened normally even when login/connectivity failed.

Additional verification performed:
Uninstalled and reinstalled 3 separate times
One of those uninstalls used GeekUninstaller (which also removes leftover registry entries), not just the standard Windows uninstaller
The exact same error reappears every time, immediately on first launch of a fresh install
